commands.summary: 12/12 Playwright cases passed across Pixel 7 Chrome, iPhone 13 viewport Chromium and iPhone 13 WebKit core.

2/2 actual scan/review journeys passed on the Pixel 7 and iPhone Chromium projects before the final handle-focus and transform-origin changes; the final V04 suite rechecked crop interactions afterward.

assertions: At 320x664, all four default edge targets have at least 44x44 CSS-pixel bounds entirely inside the crop workspace.
At a centered 20% crop, all eight handle centers receive their own pointerdown and each real drag changes only its intended crop edges in all three browser projects.
All four edge controls support keyboard resizing; the ruler supports keyboard inclination.
Image and crop frame move together before pointer release, while the original-resolution preparation still receives the selected rotation and crop.
The editor and scan entry have no horizontal overflow at 320px; the scan entry remains readable at 200% text.
The real scan journey retains user review before saving OCR rows.
physicalDeviceVerification: Not performed; no phone PASS claimed.
